svg.text: A worker watching a long test
How long the worker's turn, which a clean T3 Code install waits for, lasts, before and after this change.

g.text: Before: the watch lasts as long as the test
Working: the worker watches the test to its end (a 50 minute test holds an install for 50 minutes)
After: the watch ends by itself at nine minutes
Waiting: the turn has ended; the test runs on and its result arrives as a message
A test that ends within nine minutes looks exactly as before
Working: the test, then its result
